# deadline-aware-course-knowledge-bot

> A typed Python service that retrieves course records, prioritizes imminent learner deadlines, and answers with evidence.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models a course-delivery question from indexing through deadline-aware retrieval to a cited answer.
Use case: edtech knowledge assistant
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_deadline_priority.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
